{{Quote|Within months, the 501st gained a well deserved reputation as 'Vader's Fist.'|Entry from the 501st Journal|<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />}}
The '''501st Legion''', also known as the '''501st Battalion'''<ref name="TCWTVG">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]''</ref> or simply the '''501st''', was a [[Brigade/Legends|brigade]]-sized{{fact}} [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of elite [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] who fought under the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] through its transition into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Legion was secretly commissioned by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], who later deployed it to fight in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] with the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate's]] permission. Since its action at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], it gained a reputation as an effective fighting force, often achieving victory against overwhelming odds.

Made up of units like [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]], the 501st fought many key battles throughout the war, such as the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of Teth]] and the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], becoming one of the most well-known clone trooper legions. While fighting for the preservation of the Republic, the 501st also undertook covert operations that boosted the political agenda of Chancellor Palpatine.

The Legion's troops were initially issued standard white [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase I clone trooper armor]]. Towards the end of the Clone Wars, the soldiers transitioned to [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II armor]] with navy blue markings.

When Chancellor Palpatine - in reality the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious - issued [[Order 66]], the 501st became the personal unit of his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. He led them in [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], in which the clones helped take down the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], believing them traitors to the Republic. Shortly after the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi Purge]] and the formation of the Galactic Empire, the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] was absorbed into [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]], given [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|new armor]] and [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|new weapons]]. They quickly gained a fearsome reputation as Vader's most elite soldiers, earning them the moniker of "'''Vader's Fist''',"<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" /> and after the [[Kamino uprising]], they became the last remnant of the Grand Army of the Republic fully composed of [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] clones. In the ever-growing and diversifying army, the Fett clones were becoming a minority, with the inclusion of pools of clones from different templates, while others were birth-born recruits from Imperial academies; by [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] though, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader was known to comb through the ranks of all stormtrooper units and transferring the very best to the 501st, a fact that angered other Imperial figures- like [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] - who had to work with lesser qualified units.<ref name="CoO">''[[Choices of One]]''</ref>

Under the supervision of the [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]], Darth Vader, the Legion fought in a number of battles during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in an effort to defeat the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and bring peace to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]; however, the Alliance ultimately triumphed, and the 501st was disbanded after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

Later, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] resurrected the designation by forming a new 501st Legion. The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] also added more diverse recruits to the 501st, including [[Alien/Legends|non-humans]]. The reconstituted 501st was stationed in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], where they protected Thrawn's [[Empire of the Hand]]. Over a century later, the Legion was in the service of a [[Fel Empire|new Empire]], by then under the rule of [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]].

When Fel was deposed by the Sith Lord [[Darth Krayt]] shortly after the conclusion of the [[Sith–Imperial War]], the 501st Legion fell under the control of the new [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] in the year [[130 ABY]]. [[137 ABY|Seven years later]], however, Fel returned from exile and joined in the [[Second Imperial Civil War|war]] against Krayt in order to reclaim his throne. Under the leadership of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Oron Jaeger]], the 501st deserted the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Lord's Galactic Empire]] in order to join the [[Empire-in-exile|Fel faction]].

==History==
===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|It's been said that the 501st got the best of the war. We also got the worst.|Opening entry from the 501st Journal|<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />}}
[[File:RexandCompany-Imdb.png|thumb|left|200px|Captain Rex and Torrent Company, 501st Legion.]]
The [[Clone trooper/Legends|troopers]] of the 501st [[Legion/Legends|Legion]] were [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], who had been selected by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]–turned–[[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to be the template for an elite army. Cloned by expert [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]], the troopers were given top-notch training in many fields, as they were designed to be the ultimate soldiers.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref><ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

The 501st Legion first fought for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the opening battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" /><ref name="AOTC" /> The Legion's first mission after being deployed on the surface of Geonosis was to establish a defensive position near the wreckage of a crashed [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|''Hardcell''-class interstellar transport]]. Command initially sent out a lone clone trooper from the 501st to recon ahead and eliminate the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] who were scouting the area. The clone trooper was soon ordered destroy a damaged [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank/Legends|IG-227 ''Hailfire''-class droid tank]] with a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]] before sending in the rest of the 501st. Engineers attached to the Legion were then tasked to repair both a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] and an [[Power droid/Legends|ammunition droid]] to heal and rearm the other ground troops.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

The Legion later commandeered an [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|All Terrain Tactical Enforcer]] to destroy the incoming [[OG-9 homing spider droid/Legends|OG-9 homing spider droids]] who were closing in on the crash site. After accomplishing this task, [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|Clone Jet Troopers]] assigned to the 501st were ordered to retrieve a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] located on top of the crashed star ship and return it to their staging area. The unit was later ordered to capture and secure a small enemy outpost on the hill next to the crash site, where they established an over watch position to provide sniper cover to deal with infantry and heavy support to deal with Hail Fire Droids and Spider Walkers. Eventually the Jedi Master [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] joined the 501st Legion and led them in a counter attack against the CIS forces, managing to capture a forward position that provided CIS a much needed advantage on the battlefield. The rest of the CIS Droid Army eventually fled the planet and the Clone Army proved victorious with the 501st gaining a reputation as the ultimate soldiers for their efforts in fighting the Droid Army.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

Earlier in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC" /><ref name="TCWf" /> [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had founded the 501st Legion by moving a number of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] to a secret location on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] known only to the Chancellor's most trusted advisers, far away from the normal training center on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. These clones were given special training by Palpatine's command staff to make the 501st the most feared [[Legion/Legends|legion]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Some members of the legion would be covertly transferred to other units; however, they were tracked to ensure that they would be available in the future if they were ever needed for any special assignments, as Palpatine suspected they would be.<ref name="db" /> The 501st fought on various fronts during the war, with different companies and divisions fighting throughout the galaxy.

The 501st's elite Torrent Company was assigned to serve under [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]]. With Skywalker's help, the 501st quickly earned a reputation for incredible victories, often snatching victory from the jaws of defeat.<ref name="db" /> Among the 501st's earliest battles was the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], where they served under Skywalker, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex, and [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. Based out of [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]], the 501st troops managed to recapture [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] from the Confederacy, beating back Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom's]] multiple assaults. However, Loathsom soon deployed a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] to protect his [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[Troop/Legends|troops]], and the clone troopers were forced to pull back and defend the Republic's [[AV-7 Antivehicle Cannon/Legends|heavy cannons]]. After Skywalker and his newly assigned [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], destroyed the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], the heavy cannons annihilated the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and forced the Separatists to surrender.<ref name="TCWf" /><ref name="TCWn" />

Immediately following the Republic victory on Christophsis, the 501st [[Company/Legends|detachment]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] was sent with Skywalker, Tano, and Rex to [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] to recover [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] son, [[Rotta/Legends|Rotta]], in order to gain access to [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] passing through [[Hutt Space/Legends|Jabba's territory]] for the Grand Army. Ferried to Teth's surface in [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]], the Republic unit began a [[Battle of Teth/Legends|grueling campaign]] up the vertical face of a cliff to the [[B'omarr Monastery]] where Rotta was being held. Utilizing [[All Terrain Tactical Enforcer/Legends|AT-TE walkers]] and [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hooks]], Torrent Company was able to defeat the Separatist battle droids holding the monastery, though half of the unit was lost on the way up. After Skywalker and Tano located and rescued Rotta from the depths of the castle, the Confederate forces—under the command of [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]—launched a counterattack on the Teth monastery. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and clone troops were forced to barricade themselves inside the stronghold, losing three-quarters of their remaining forces in defending the castle. Skywalker and his Padawan then left to find medical assistance for Rotta, leaving Rex in command of the troops.<ref name="TCWn" /><ref name="TCWf" />

[[File:Battle_of_Teth_1.png|thumb|right|250px|Torrent Company is surrounded by droids in the Teth monastery.]]
Ventress and her forces were soon able to break through the monastery door's controls, and the defense of the monastery cost Rex all but five troopers. The Captain and the rest of the survivors launched a last stand against the battle droids. [[General/Legends|General]] Kenobi and the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]] eventually arrived at Teth, reinforcing the remnants of the 501st and securing the defeat of the Separatists. A treaty was established between the Republic and Jabba the Hutt,<ref name="TCWn" /><ref name="TCWf" /> but although the 501st was replenished with new troops, the loss of the original Torrent Company left scars on all involved. Soon after, Rex and troops of the 501st were redeployed with Skywalker and Tano aboard their recently-christened [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]] to protect [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] from the Confederate General [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]], who was intent on capturing the planet. Departing from Coruscant,<ref name="Wild Space">''[[The Clone Wars: Wild Space]]''</ref> Skywalker's forces eventually arrived at Bothawui and defeated Grievous, securing a Republic victory.<ref name="Downfall of a Droid">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref> 501st troopers Rex and [[Denal/Legends|Denal]]<ref name="CW Tactics Denal">{{SWPM|set=Clone Wars Tactics|cardname=Denal}}</ref> also helped Skywalker and Tano in [[Raid on Skytop Station/Legends|destroying]] the Separatist [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]].<ref name="Duel of the Droids">{{TCW|Duel of the Droids}}</ref>

Rex, Tano, [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Clone Sergeant]] [[Coric]], and six new Torrent Company recruits—[[Ross (clone trooper)|Ross]], [[Boro]], [[Joc]], [[Hil]], [[Vere]], and [[Ince]]—later participated in a routine shakedown cruise aboard Captain [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon's]] [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|assault ship]], the ''[[Leveler]]'', in the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]]. However, their short respite from the war ended when they were called in to rescue the [[Republic Intelligence/Legends|Republic Intelligence]] agent [[Hallena Devis]], who had been taken hostage by rebel forces in opposition to the [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] of the nearby [[JanFathal]]. Receiving assistance from the [[Altisian Jedi]] sect as well as Skywalker, the task force was ultimately successful in [[Battle of JanFathal|extracting and rescuing]] Devis; however, troopers Vere and Ince were killed in the mission.<ref name="No Prisoners">''[[The Clone Wars: No Prisoners]]''</ref> Torrent Company itself continued to endure losses even after the JanFathal mission.<ref name="Gambit: Stealth">''[[Clone Wars Gambit: Stealth]]''</ref> Rex inducted rookie troopers [[Fives/Legends|ARC-5555]]<ref name="Rookies">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref> and [[Echo/Legends|CT-21-0408]],<ref name="TCW CharEn">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> respectively nicknamed "Fives" and "Echo," into the 501st for their service in [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|recapturing]] a [[Rishi Station/Legends|Republic outpost]] from the Separatists and alerting the Republic to an impeding Confederate attack on Kamino.<ref name="Rookies" /> A few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later, Rex, Fives, Echo, and other elements of the 501st were serving with Skywalker and Kenobi on board the former's flagship, the [[Resolute/Legends|''Resolute'']],<ref name="Defenders of the Republic">''[[The Clone Wars: Defenders of the Republic]]''</ref> when they were assigned to stage a defense of Kamino, which was being [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|targeted]] by Grievous, Ventress, and the Separatists. The Jedi and the 501st rushed to the clones' [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] and were able to prevent the Confederacy from stealing a sample of the clones' [[DNA/Legends|DNA]], and Fives and Echo were promoted to the prestigious rank of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] for their valiant service in the campaign.<ref name="ARC Troopers">{{TCW|ARC Troopers (episode)}}</ref>

[[File:EchoFivesSniperPosition-ARCT.png|thumb|left|250px|Echo and Fives of the 501st defending Kamino from a Separatist invasion.]]
The 501st also served with Skywalker and Tano in reinforcing Jedi General [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], who was being [[Sky Battle of Quell|ambushed]] by a Separatist fleet over [[Quell/Legends|Quell]]. Arriving at Quell aboard the ''Resolute'', 501st troops were deployed in LAAT/i gunships to board Secura's [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]],<ref name="Jedi Crash">{{TCW|Jedi Crash}}</ref><ref name="Jedi Crash Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode013.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Jedi Crash}}</ref> the [[Liberty (Venator-class)/Legends|''Liberty'']],<ref name="Jedi Crash Decoded">{{TCW|Jedi Crash|d=y}}</ref> which was under attack by [[B2-RP battle droid/Legends|rocket droids]]. Skywalker and Tano rescued Secura and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Bly/Legends|CC-5052]] from the damaged [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], but their [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|escape cruiser's]] [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] was accidentally tripped by a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid]] attack. The group mistakenly jumped to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], leaving [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] in command of the remaining troops.<ref name="Jedi Crash" /> The 501st's Torrent Company later helped to [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|retake]] the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony world [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] from General Grievous, serving there under Kenobi, Tano, Rex, and Coric. Upon arrival at Kothlis aboard the Republic Star Destroyer [[Indomitable (Republic cruiser)|''Indomitable'']], Torrent Company joined in the battle to regain control of Kothlis's [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|spynet]] facility. Although the campaign was ultimately a success, it saw the unit's greatest depletion since the Battle of Teth. The injured clones from the 501st company were sent to the [[Kaliida Shoals Medical Center/Legends|Kaliida Shoals Medical Center]] for treatment, Rex and Coric among them.<ref name="Gambit: Stealth" />

The legion also participated in "[[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|mopping up]]" the remaining droid forces on the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] shortly after the world's liberation from the Confederacy, helping Skywalker and Tano to defeat the droids based out of the ruined city of [[Resdin]].<ref name="Republic Heroes" /> Eventually, Rex and a 501st contingent were sent to reconnoiter [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], where evidence of Separatist droid foundries had been [[Mission to Cato Neimoidia/Legends|discovered]]. Upon arriving in orbit of the world, the task force was unable to make contact with the clones on the surface but ran preliminary scans and discovered the droid foundries in the planet's northern and southern hemispheres. In his report to the Jedi Council, Rex recommended a full-scale invasion to retake Geonosis, and the Jedi Council used the information to mount an [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|assault]] on Geonosis<ref name="Prelude to Point Rain">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091103fd/index.html|text=Fan Days Script: A Prelude to "Point Rain"}}</ref> that was ultimately successful.<ref name="Brain Invaders">{{TCW|Brain Invaders}}</ref>

[[File:RexRelaysOrders-TG.png|thumb|right|250px|CT-7567 relays the plan of attack to the 501st clone troopers on Umbara]]

Later in the war, the planet [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] seceded from the Galactic Republic and joined the Separatist cause.<ref name="EncyclopediaUmbara">{{SWE|locations|umbara|Umbara}}</ref> As a result, the Republic launched a [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|massive campaign]] to retake the planet through military force. When the Republic invasion army arrived on Umbara, the clone troopers of the 501st Legion spearheaded the assault under the command of General Anakin Skywalker and Captain Rex. The initial objective was to capture the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], and the success of the campaign ultimately depended on the 501st Legion. Upon landing on the planet's surface, however, the 501st immediately encountered heavy resistance from the [[Umbaran soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Umbaran/Legends|Umbaran]] [[Umbaran militia|Militia]]. Although the 501st suffered some casualties in the first wave of the invasion, Skywalker and his troopers ultimately succeeded in repelling the Umbarans.<ref name="DOU" />

When Skywalker allowed the 501st time to rest before continuing the march to the capital, the Umbarans ambushed the unsuspecting Jedi and clones. Their position was resecured when General [[Pong Krell/Legends|Pong Krell]] and a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]] cleared the area of hostiles with a bombing run. Afterward, Krell informed Skywalker that he was ordered to return to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by command of the Jedi High Council and at the request of Chancellor Palpatine. With Skywalker removed from the campaign, General Krell became the temporary commanding officer of the 501st Legion for the duration of Skywalker's absence.<ref name="DOU" />

Some of the clones in the 501st, such as Captain Rex and Arc trooper Fives, had grown accustomed to Anakin Skywalker's personal approach to leadership. Thus, they were unprepared for Pong Krell's different command style, which centered on discipline and military protocol. While the rest of the clones obeyed their Jedi officer without question, Rex and Fives came to privately and openly question the general's strategy. Prior to the Umbara campaign, Krell built a reputation as a successful general whose unwavering focus on military objectives won many key victories in the Clone Wars. This track record for success also included high casualty rates among the clones who served under him. A stern and unyielding Jedi Master, Krell had no tolerance for failure or insubordination.<ref name="SWEKrell">{{SWE|characters|generalpongkrell|General Pong Krell}}</ref><ref name="DOU" />

[[File:Epguide408.png|thumb|left|250px|General Pong Krell, Captain CT-7567 and the 501st Legion on Umbara]]

Due to the significance of the 501st Legion's part in the campaign,<ref name="EncyclopediaUmbara" /> Krell ordered the clones to launch a frontal assault on the capital and overcome any resistance with the full force of Republic military might. But when their position was compromised by the Umbarans, Rex ordered his troopers to retreat. The general was outraged by their withdrawal, but also ordered more clones to reinforce Rex and his men. After the Umbarans fell in retreat, Krell confronted Rex for disregarding his orders. Fives intervened by openly criticizing the general in front of the other troopers, but then stood down after being ordered to do so at the point of a lightsaber. In order to defuse the situation, Rex asserted how his loyalty to the general conflicted with his concern for the clones. Krell was actually surprised by Rex, given the fact that most clones obeyed orders without question, and somewhat complimented the captain for his tenacity. Before Rex and Fives could contemplate Krell's words, however, another group of Umbaran soldiers ambushed them, and the 501st were forced to resume the fighting.<ref name="DOU" />

The 501st Legion received its next objective when they were ordered to disable an Umbaran [[Airbase/Legends|airbase]] in order to sever its supply lines to the capital city, therefore making the enemy stronghold more vulnerable to military assault. During this time, some troopers within the 501st argued over General Pong Krell's command style. Fives and [[Jesse/Legends|Jesse]] strongly disapproved of Krell's strategies because of his lack of concern for clone lives; [[Dogma/Legends|Dogma]] was fiercely loyal to his general and took the opportunity to defend Krell's tactics against the others' doubts; [[Hardcase/Legends|Hardcase]] was unconcerned with his comrades' dilemma and only wanted more opportunities to kill enemy combatants. Although Captain Rex retained his own misgivings over Krell's tactics, he wanted to honor his code of loyalty by faithfully executing the general's will without question. As Fives became increasingly outspoken and critical, Rex reminded him that Krell was an effective leader, citing the Jedi Master's extensive record of key military victories. Furthermore, Rex also reminded Fives that the duty of every clone—every soldier—was to obey their orders and, when necessary, to sacrifice their lives for victory.<ref name="The General">{{TCW|The General (episode)}}</ref>

The fierce Umbaran resistance that stood between the 501st and the airbase caused Rex to amend General Krell's original plan by dispatching Fives and Hardcase on a covert mission to infiltrate the targeted location and steal a pair of [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighters]]. At the same time, Rex and his troopers pressed with the forward assault, in accordance with the general's strict orders. Fives and Hardcase ultimately succeeded in their mission and, with their commandeered fighters, caused significant damage to the airbase before coming to the aid of Rex and his men. As the airbase was engulfed in flames, Krell ordered [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Appo/Legends|Appo]] to send the rest of the 501st to reinforce Rex's troops. Shortly afterward, the surviving Umbarans were captured and the fallen airbase was secured under Republic control.<ref name="The General" />

===End of the war===
{{Quote|In our bones, we knew the war was almost over. The galaxy held its breath, waiting to see which side would make the final, daring move. As fortune would have it, the Republic moved first.|Entry from the 501st Journal|<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />}}
[[File:Mygeeto.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The 501st Legion engages Separatist forces on Mygeeto while also executing a mission for Chancellor Palpatine.]]
In the final years of the war, the 501st was frequently shuttled across the galaxy, often divided into specialized groups to assist other missions that would prove vital to the Republic's eventual victory. The Legion had went through some significant changes during the final year of the war. Sometime during this period, overall command of the Legion was given to Sergeant Appo, who had been promoted to [[Clone Marshal Commander/Legends|Commander]] and led the 501st through the final battles of the Clone Wars.

Under the orders of Chancellor Palpatine, the 501st would sometimes operate outside of the usual command structure, with detachments of the unit serving at many pivotal campaigns to fulfill his political agenda. It was around this time that members of the 501st became aware of what they would eventually have to do regarding the Jedi, with some troopers either regarding them with remorse or disdain for what would eventually happen to them. Regardless, the 501st continued to serve under the faithfully Jedi in the Clone Wars while waiting for the eventual kill order that they would have to carry out.

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the final year of the war, the 501st took part in several battles pivotal in ending the war. The Legion had participated in the [[Battle of Mygeeto]], where they were tasked with destroying a droid energy collector, but were secretly involved in [[Hammertong/Legends|Project Hammertong]], a classified mission to acquire a Mygeetan power crystal from the energy collector that was authorized by Supreme Chancellor Palpatine, who secretly had plans of using the crystal as a power source for his [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] project. From their staging ground, the 501st fought through a war torn bridge and managed to capture CIS's forward command post. After destroying two enemy heavy turrets, the Legion was joined by Jedi General [[Ki-Adi-Mundi]], who assisted the elite clones in destroying the CIS barricades and capture a lookout point that would prove vital to their mission. The troopers of the 501st found it difficult to keep Mundi in the dark about their true objective, as the Jedi Master was already suspicious of Palpatine and kept a close eye on the 501st's activities. After fighting their way to the energy collector, the Legion managed to destroy the shield generators protecting the collector and destroyed it, secretly taking the power crystal with them out of sight of General Mundi. As Mundi and the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic marines]] continued their assault against the CIS, the 501st returned to their staging area across the bridge where an LAAT/i Gunship awaited to pick up the power crystal from its courier, immediately taking off once the hand off was complete.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" /> Following the operations, the members of the 501st who fought alongside General Mundi realized that the Jedi were capable of being fooled.

Shortly before the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], members of the 501st were stationed on Coruscant, where they were used to carry out security patrols.<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> Like many other ground based units, the clones of the 501st spent the majority of their down time in flight simulators preparing for space combat as [[Clone trooper pilot|Pilots]] at that time had become scarce. Not long afterward, the 501st fought in the Battle of Coruscant in an effort to rescue the kidnapped Chancellor Palpatine from the Confederacy. Members of the legion, many flying [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] in battle for the first time, were tasked with destroying a number of [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in an effort to create a diversion, before being tasked with targeting a Confederate cruiser that was escorting General Grievous's flag ship, the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']]. They were ultimately successful in clearing the way for Generals Skywalker and Kenobi as they were able to get on board and rescue the Chancellor.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

The Legion later fought in the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]] to reinforce the [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]], where many of the 501st found the conditions of the fungal planet and its hostile inhabitants to be hellish. A few months into the battle, members of the 501st had begun to crack under pressure and began to fall victim to both flesh eating diseases and the hostile wild life, believing that their superiors on Coruscant had abandoned them on the unforgiving world. What kept the Legion fighting strong was their Jedi Commander, [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]], who's iron will against the Separatist forces kept the 501st in high spirits. At some point during the battle, the Legion's forward unit was attacked by unknown creatures and communications from them ceased. A second unit of the 501st was sent in to give them fire support, although by the time they got there, the forward unit had already been massacred and their AT-TE was rendered inoperable. The second unit soon came under attack by a pack of wild [[Acklay/Legends|Acklays]], but were ultimately able to defeat them. Upon driving off the wild Acklays, Command ordered them to hold out against incoming CIS forces near the downed AT-TE until Master Secura arrived with reinforcements. Upon her arrival, Secura and the 501st were tasked with retrieving a power cell from a crashed LAAT/I Gunship to repair the AT-TE. Once the walker was fully operational, the 501st were ordered to destroy the CIS heavy turrets that were set up near their base camp, eventually driving the CIS out of the area. Once their orders came through to leave the planet, Master Secura came to see them off personally, a gesture which made many of them being unable to look her in the eye due to their knowledge of Order 66, with one trooper later hoping that when her death did come, it was quick.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

After that battle, a detachment of the 501st were dispatched to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to assist in repelling the Separatist invasion of the planet until reinforcements could arrive. While the troopers in the 501st remained dedicated to completing their mission, some members saw the operation as a text book suicide mission and believed that the only way anyone was getting off planet was in a body bag. When they jumped out of hyperspace, they found the planet blockaded by the Separatists. The 501st was forced to punch a hole in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]], starting out by targeting and destroying two [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|CIS Frigates]] and later taking out the CIS flagship's main cannons as they were doing significant damages to the Republic flagship's shields. Afterwards, some pilots were called back to their main hanger where they and a strike team of clone marines were tasked with flying an LAAT into the enemy hangar. Once onboard, the strike team was tasked with destroying the ship's life support systems and engine cooling tanks, crippling the enemy vessel. Needing Intel on the CIS's strategy, the strike team was ordered to steal a set of attack plans for the upcoming battle and return it to their cruiser using the LAAT. Upon the strike team's return with the CIS battle plans, the 501st set a course to enter the planets atmosphere. As they entered the surface of the ancient forest world, many troopers of the 501st began to contemplate on why so many of their own had to die for the sake of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], who they considered to be nothing more than a "bunch of walking carpets."<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

The 501st detachment soon landed on the planet's surface, where they discovered that things were just as bad as they feared before touching down. Learning they were heavily outnumbered by the CIS forces, the 501st initially had low hopes for victory until they encountered the Wookiee Warriors. Being the first time that they fought alongside Wookiees, the members of the 501st Legion were very much surprised by the Wookiee's incredible strength and formidably fierce on the battle field, something that none of the 501st were counting on. Along with the Wookiees, the Legion [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|fought alongside]] the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]]<ref name="SWPM1">{{SWPM|set=Order 66|cardname=41st Elite Corps AT-RT|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipo13c.jpg}}</ref><ref name="SWPM2">{{SWPM|set=Order 66|cardname=41st Elite Corps BARC Speeders|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipo02a.jpg}}</ref> and Jedi Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who were defending a Wookiee oil refinery that was crucial in their efforts to drive the CIS off world. The 501st were initially tasked with holding off the Droid army by holding the beach head until reinforcements arrived. Fighting alongside the Wookiees, the troopers of the 501st were initially able to hold their own against the massive droid army, but they were eventually overrun and the surviving troopers were forced to retreat back to the Wookiee Stronghold where the refinery was kept. Upon reaching the refinery, command informed them that the Separatist's were planning to destroy the facility, which would cause the entire complex to explode. Ordered to hold the refinery at all costs, the 501st fought off the incoming CIS forces until Master Yoda arrived, who then led the Legion in a counter attack by taking over several strategic points across the battlefield, eventually forcing the CIS to retreat.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

Following this battle, many of the 501st could tell that they were reaching the end of the war with some saying that they could feel it in their very bones. Soon a detachment of the 501st was transferred to [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] to assist General Obi-Wan Kenobi and the 212th Attack Battalion in capturing of General Grievous, who was currently holed up on the sink hole filled planet. Being dropped near the CIS controlled Hanger 10, the 501st were tasked with assaulting and capturing a two story building that the CIS were using as an outpost, wanting to use it as a lookout point for their mission. Once this was accomplished, the 501st were ordered to capture an enemy position further down the highway, destroying any enemies they encountered. After taking control of the area, Obi-Wan arrived to assist the 501st in taking over Hanger 10. After clearing out the hanger, Obi-Wan and the 501st were confronted by Grievous, who proceeded to attack them and the Jedi Master. While he proved to be dangerous enemy, Grievous was ultimately forced to retreat with Obi-Wan in pursuit of him. The 501st were then tasked with destroying Hanger 10's Anti-Aircraft Turrets so that air support could deliver a [[Hovertank/Legends|Fighter tank]] to their location. Upon the tanks arrival, the 501st were ordered to destroy an [[ATX energy pillar|ATX Energy Pillar]], ultimately removing the CIS's hold over the area. Upon completing this objective, command praised the 501st for a job well done and ordered them to pull out for their next assignment. It was not long after that General Kenobi was ultimately able to kill the Confederacy's [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]], Grievous, something which the 501st would've normally celebrated, although their next orders put a hold on those thoughts.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

===Fall of the Republic===
{{Quote|What I remember about the rise of the Empire is… is how quiet it was. During the waning hours of the Clone Wars, the 501st Legion was discreetly transferred back to Coruscant. It was a silent trip; we all knew what was about to happen, what we were about to do. Did we have any doubts? Any private traitorous thoughts? Perhaps, but no one said a word. Not on the flight back to Coruscant, not when Order 66 came down, and not when we marched into the Jedi Temple. Not a word.|Entry from the 501st Journal|<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />}}
[[File:Knightfall1.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Vader leads the 501st Legion up the steps of the Jedi Temple to destroy the Jedi Order.]]
As the battle was winding down, a group of clones from the 501st was discreetly transferred back to Coruscant, in preparation for [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]—a top-secret order given by Chancellor Palpatine which stated that the Jedi had rebelled against the Republic, and needed to be eliminated. On Coruscant, the 501st rendezvoused with the Sith Lord Darth Vader, formerly known as Anakin Skywalker, and were given their orders: destroy the Jedi. Though they appreciated the Jedi, their loyalty lay first with Palpatine, as all clone troopers had been taught to obey the Supreme Chancellor first and foremost. Vader led them into the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], ready for battle. Though some may have held quiet doubts about what they were commanded to do, years of psychological programming and conditioning prevented any of them from resisting such an extreme order, and so they said nothing.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

With their inability to resist morally-questionable orders, the 501st Legion steadily marched behind Darth Vader and towards the main entrance of the Jedi Temple. Then they carried out Order 66 to the letter by attacking every Jedi in their path, from Masters and Knights to Padawans and younglings. The Legion was initially met with armed resistance from the Jedi Temple Security Force, who remained loyal to the Jedi and tried to assist the them in preventing the 501st from capturing the [[Jedi Council Chamber]], but were ultimately overrun and killed by the elite clone troopers. The Legion was soon tasked to prevent the Jedi from destroying the [[Holobook/Legends|Holobooks]] within the [[Jedi Library]], using engineers to keep the bookcases intact while the rest of the Legion fought hard to keep the Jedi back. After scanning the contents of the library, the 501st were ordered to retrieve two Holocrons rumored to contain both Sith and Jedi knowledge. Knowing that the first Holocron was in the Temple's Communications Center, members of the 501st fought through several Jedi defending the Holocron, killing them and retrieving the Holocron. It was not long after that Darth Vader arrived to support the 501st in their mission when they we're ordered to retrieve a second Holocron from a Jedi Master who tried to protect it. Vader and the 501st eventually killed this Jedi and retrieved the Holocron which was soon handed off to a LAAT/I which took off immediately once it had the second Holocron. Eventually, Vader and the 501st were ordered to eliminate three Jedi Masters who were coordinating the efforts of other Jedi against the 501st. While the three Masters proved themselves to be deadly opponents against the 501st, they we're eventually slaughtered and the defense of the other Jedi soon began to crumble.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

While most of the senior members of the Jedi Order scattered throughout the galaxy on various fronts, the Temple's remaining occupants were left in a hopeless position as Vader and the 501st clone troopers turned the Temple into a scene of slaughter and mayhem. Though the 501st suffered their own fair share of casualties, and even though several Jedi were able to escape from the doomed battle, the clones' superb training and Vader's relentless onslaught resulted in the deaths of almost every Jedi within the Temple.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" /> Meanwhile, Palpatine was transmitting Order 66 around the galaxy to different clone commanders. Nearly all obeyed their orders without question, killing their unsuspecting Jedi officers who made the mistake of trusting the clones with their lives.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

[[File:Jedi_Purge.png|thumb|right|250px|The 501st Legion purges the Jedi Temple with orders to spare no one.]]
The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] tracked a number of suspected Jedi, such as [[Tru Veld/Legends|Tru Veld]], and called in the 501st for assistance in capturing them. The legion also [[Skirmish on Shinarcan Bridge Extension|attacked]] and killed a number of Jedi on [[Shinarcan Bridge Extension|Shinarcan Bridge]] a couple of hours after the declaration of Order 66, and Jedi Knight [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] was killed by a fellow Jedi when she tried to stop him from killing one of the 501st troopers.<ref name="Order66" /> Following the extermination of the Jedi, [[Decoy Squad Five]] was tasked with deceiving any Jedi that returned to the Temple in order to kill them, though the eight-member squad was later killed by Obi-Wan Kenobi and Yoda, who had managed to escape the carnage and return to Coruscant.<ref name="ROTS novel" /> The 501st troopers that remained behind to occupy the Temple attempted to kill Kenobi and Yoda, only to be wiped out by the two Jedi Masters.<ref name="ROTS" />

===Imperial rule===
{{Quote|We were establishing a new era, an era of order and peace.|Entry from the 501st Journal|<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />}}
[[File:501st_Commandos.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Imperial commandos of the 501st Legion.]]
A short time after the execution of Order 66, Palpatine would announce that he was reorganizing the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], which he would rule as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. Now serving the Empire, the members of the 501st took the designation of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]], as well as new [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armor]], [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|weapons]], and [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|ships]]. In the years to come, they would fight in a number of pivotal battles and continued to serve under the direct command of Vader,<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" /> [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander]] of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]].<ref name="kenner" /> The legion was often deployed in places where its advanced fighting skills could be used to make a political statement. Most of its missions were classified, so as to hide what it was doing from the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].<ref name="TFUCG">''[[The Force Unleashed Campaign Guide]]''</ref> In the years following Order 66, the 501st would fight on a number of mop-up missions against either remnants of the Confederacy or the few Jedi that had managed to survive Order 66.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" /><ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" /> To assist in the hunt for Jedi survivors, clone deserters, and varied Imperial dissidents, Vader brought together the ARC troopers and [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]] who had formerly served in the Republic's [[Special Operations Brigade/Legends|Special Operations Brigade]] and formed a new [[Special forces/Legends|special forces]] unit that was attached to the 501st Legion. Known as the [[Imperial Commando Special Unit]], the Imperial 501st's veteran [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] were responsible for the [[Mission to Celen|death]] of Jedi Master [[Iri Camas]] on [[Celen]] and for [[Mission to Coth Fuuras space station|killing]] the Jedi Knight [[Borik Yelgo]] aboard the [[Coth Fuuras space station]].<ref name="ImpCom501">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>

A short time after Order 66, the 501st Legion went on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] to help Darth Vader take down the Jedi [[Conclave on Kessel|conclave]] there. Vader fought against a total of eight Jedi, and though he was wounded, the 501st aided him in killing them. When it was over, the eight Jedi lay dead. Vader's reputation, along with that of the 501st, grew tremendously with this victory.<ref name="Purge">[[Purge (comic book)|''Purge'']]</ref> On the planet [[New Plympto/Legends|New Plympto]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Vill]] led a detachment of the 501st against [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] forces still loyal to the Confederacy. The Nosaurians held out for a time, but Vill and his men succeeded in defeating the rebels at the [[Cleansing of New Plympto|Battle of Half-Axe Pass]].<ref name="Star Wars: Dark Times: The Path to Nowhere" />

[[File:MassacreofNewPlympto.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Commander Vill's 501st stormtroopers massacre a group of unarmed prisoners.]]
The 501st followed [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Vader to [[Murkhana/Legends|Murkhana]], where they confronted a [[Ion Team|group of clones]] who had refused to execute Order 66. Vader killed most of them and had the rest taken into custody, and then led his men to Kashyyyk once more, where they [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|fought against]] a group of Jedi who had survived Order 66. Led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Appo/Legends|Appo]], they killed and enslaved tens of thousands of [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] in an effort to gain workers for the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor's]] new secret project, the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] superweapon. Some of the Jedi, including Master [[Roan Shryne]], were killed. However, before dying, Shryne managed to kill Appo.<ref name="Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader" /> Vader then brought a unit from the 501st with him on a visit to the devastated planet of [[Honoghr/Legends|Honoghr]]. There, they were attacked by the native [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], who proved to be a match for the elite stormtroopers. Impressed, the Dark Lord devised a plan to enslave the [[Species/Legends|species]] and use them as his personal [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]].<ref name="EotJ">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref>

In late [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Emperor Palpatine dispatched Lord Vader on an assignment to rescue [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garoche Tarkin]], the son of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] who disappeared while hunting down insurgents in the [[Atoan system|Atoa system]] of the [[Ghost Nebula/Legends|Ghost Nebula]]—a barely explored area in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Stormtrooper Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Voca]] and two battalions of the 501st Legion were placed under Vader's direct command for the mission. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Shale (human)|Shale]], a friend of Admiral Tarkin and trusted subordinate to [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] Tarkin, was sent on the mission as well. Once the Imperials arrived at the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Atoa/Legends|Atoa]], the [[Clone stormtrooper|stormtrooper clones]] launched a brutal and merciless assault on an [[Atoan]] city, killing most of its defenders while the Dark Lord of the Sith personally led the attack. Voca obeyed Vader's orders without question hesitance, even when commanded to execute anyone old enough to hold a weapon, as well as to drown defenseless prisoners in a river.<ref name="DVLC1" />

[[File:Atoa_attack.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The 501st lay waste to an Atoan city on Atoa.]]
After locating the remains of Garoche Tarkin's missing Star Destroyer, Voca and squadron of 501st [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|V-wing starfighters]] assisted Vader and Shale with their inspections of the destroyed warship. However, the Imperials were caught completely off guard by a group of Atoan starfighters, mainly because the 501st failed to thoroughly sweep the area and thus fell into a trap. Regardless, superior technology, superb training and the leadership of the demanding Supreme Commander helped the Legion to turn the tide and defeat their ambushers. When a captured pilot revealed to Vader that Tarkin was held on an unknown world that was covered in tar-pits, Vader ordered Voca to assemble the 501st and prepare for a ground assault.<ref name="DVLC2">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 2|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 2]]</ref>

The rescue attempt ultimately proved to be costly effort. The planet's tar-pits made it almost impossible for the [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT Walkers]] to operate effectively. As a result, more than a few Walkers, including several 501st squads, were lost while trying to attack an Atoan city that was built to move like a ship on the tar-pits. The direct assault, however, was only meant to serve as a distraction so that Vader, Shale [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Saro]] and a company of [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]] could infiltrate the city and execute a stealth attack. Though they succeeded in capturing the bridge crew, they failed to retrieve Tarkin since the admiral was not in the city as they were led to believe.<ref name="DVLC3">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 3|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 3]]</ref>

Up until the botched attempt to rescue Tarkin on the tar-pit covered world, the 501st Legion suffered few casualties. But on Darth Vader's Star Destroyer, a mutiny broke out and caught the Imperials completely by surprise. Shale betrayed the Empire and incited the storm commandos to commit the ultimate act of treachery by attempting to assassinate Vader. Although Vader survived the attempt on his life, most of the ship's crew were not as fortunate. All of the [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] were executed and many stormtroopers were killed by their mutinous clone brothers. Commander Voca and the troopers with him managed to survive long enough for Vader to assist them against the commandos.<ref name="DVLC4">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 4|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 4]]</ref>

[[File:VadersFist-TSS.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Vader's Fist was feared throughout the galaxy]]
After executing the last of the traitors on the Star Destroyer, Vader and his remaining troop were forced to evacuate the warship due to Shale's sabotage. Though they managed to escape before the vessel's destruction, their [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] was severely damaged after crash landing on another unknown world in the Atoa system. Vader, Voca and eight stormtroopers survived the crash; the rest of the 501st soldiers were dead. The Imperials were then ambushed by a large force of Atoan insurgents. Outnumbered and exhausted, the 501st were utterly unprepared to defend themselves, thus forcing Vader to confront the enemy alone while Voca and his troops tried to escape to safety. Their path was cut off, however, by the traitor Shale and a group of insurgents. Shale half-halfheartedly apologized to the commander before ordering his men to execute the last soldiers of Darth Vader's lost command.<ref name="DVLC4" />

Despite the loss of Commander Voca and the two battalions of the 501st Legion, Darth Vader was ultimately able to complete his true mission for the Emperor, which was to assassinate Garoche Tarkin so that his father would grow to hate the Empire's enemies even more than he already did. At first, Vader was captured and rendered helpless. But his self-hatred and desperation strengthened the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of]] [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] within him, thus allowing him to break free and eventually kill Shale, Lady Saro and Garoche Tarkin, all of whom had betrayed him and the Empire. Though he nearly killed himself in the process, Emperor Palpatine was able to have Vader retrieved and repaired on Coruscant.<ref name="DVLC5">[[Darth Vader and the Lost Command 5|''Darth Vader and the Lost Command'' 5]]</ref>

Another crucial mission took place a [[18 BBY/Legends|year after]] the Empire's rise. After many of Naboo's ambassadors were sent home in various forms of dismemberment, the Naboo's current leader, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Apailana/Legends|Apailana]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] greatly disapproved of the Empire and its policies, including the systematic extermination of the Jedi Order. Thus, she secretly used her political connections as Queen to find and take in any Jedi fugitives that were seeking protection. As the Empire swiftly strengthened its rule over the galaxy, Queen Apailana broke off diplomatic ties in order to explore military options. In response to Naboo's act of defiance, the 501st Legion was [[Battle of Naboo (Imperial Period)|dispatched]] to Naboo's capital of [[Theed]] with orders to assassinate the queen, her bodyguards and any Jedi found on the planet.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

[[File:501st_Trooper_TBOH.png|thumb|left|250px|An original clone trooper of the 501st Legion]]
A relatively small detachment of the Legion was deployed into Theed in the dark of night and were tasked to destroy the Central Plaza's [[Autoturret/Legends|Autoturret grid]] and to eliminate Queen Apailana and her Jedi protectors. Although they were fewer numbers than that of Theed's Security Force, the 501st were undeterred and first proceeded to capture the Plaza Security Post and the Embasy Plaza soon afterwards. Command then tasked them with capturing the Guard Post past the Embassy and provided them with a [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|TX-130 Fighter Tank]] in case they needed the extra fire power. Taking the Guard Post cleared the way for the 501st to reach the Autoturret grid that was being control from a security terminal and were soon ordered to destroy it. Upon the destruction of the palace's automated defenses, several of the Apailana's Jedi guards broke away from the palace to face the incoming forces of the 501st head on, although they were ruthlessly killed by the elite Stormtroopers. Knowing Theed would soon be lost to the Imperials, Apailana and her surviving Jedi guards made a last ditch effort to escape city but were ultimately gunned down by the Legion.

With the opposition crushed and the capital secured, the 501st Legion's mission was a success and Naboo quickly fell back into line. It was the first time that the 501st was ordered to forcibly adjust a planet's government; similar missions would follow over the years.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

Their track record for successful missions, combined with a fearsome reputation for brutal efficiency, earned the 501st Legion the nickname "''Vader's Fist''," not in the least because their primary commanding officer was Darth Vader. As the Sith Lord's personal legion of stormtroopers, the 501st executed many top-priority assignments over the years since the end of the Clone Wars. Hence, the 501st essentially became responsible for aiding the Sith Lords in building their empire throughout the first decade of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

[[File:BF_Mustafar_3.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The 501st storms the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]].]]
Sometime after the Battle of Naboo, the 501st was sent to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|stop]] a [[Separatist holdouts/Legends#Mustafar|droid rebellion]] led by the rogue Geonosian [[Gizor Dellso]], who had somehow managed to avoid execution at the hands of Vader. When the Empire learned that Dellso discovered a hidden [[Techno Union droid factory/Legends|droid factory]], the Geonosian fugitive had already reactivated the facility and produced a [[Gizor Dellso's army|new army]] of battle droids.

The 501st were deployed via their [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] to Mustafar but found themselves surprised when they discovered the vast [[Gizor Dellso's navy|fleet]] of ships orbiting the planet. Needing to break through to the planet's surface to reach Dellso, the 501st attempted to deploy their in their starfighters but initially unable as an enemy dropship had landed in the hanger and began deploying newly constructed B-1 battledroids. Although initially caught off guard by this attack, the 501st managed to destroy the droids and their dropship before deploying in the own fighters to meet the enemy in space. After thinning out the enemies fighters, the 501st was ordered to attack enemy's [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|captital ship's]] shields and were advised to use [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE Bombers]] to inflict maximum damage. When the cruiser's shields were taken down, Command relayed an order from Lord Vader to steal one of the enemy's strike bombers. A member of the 501st soon managed to land in the enemy's hanger and stole the bomber Vader had requested, bring it back to Star Destroyer's before being congratulated by Command. Despite feeling nostalgic about facing battle droids once more, this feeling became soured by the time their fleet established orbital positions over Mustafar and were soon deployed to the planet's surface.

On Mustafar, the 501st Legion were to be inserted to the droid factory Dellso had reactivated and used to create his own private army to use against anyone who stood against him. Having honestly grown tired of facing an enemy they had once defeated in the previous war, the Legion became fiercely determined to [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|destroy]] every last remnant of the CIS.

Deployed at the nearby mining facility's landing pad, the 501st were first tasked with taking control of the Lava Observation Room and soon afterward the walkway where they cane under fire by droid snipers who tried to prevent the from crossing over the bridges connecting the two areas. Once this was accomplished, Command noted the the nearby Collection Base would be a good place to make a stand and tasked the Legion to capture it. After the position was taken, Command ordered the 501st to destroy Dellso's new [[Confederate infantry prototype]] schematics before they could be used to build another droid army. After the schematics were destroyed, command informed the Legion that one of their own was killed in the nearby conference room carrying the [[Orbital strike beacon]] needed to destroy Dellso's factory and ordered them to retrieve and bring it to the facility's Central Antenna. Once the beacon had been placed, the Legion were ordered to retreat to Collection Base where they were soon confronted by Dellso and his Geonosian bodyguards. While Dellso and his men tried to fight off the 501st, they were ultimately shot down and killed. Dellso's mining facility was [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombarded]] shortly after his death and the men of the 501st found themselves being able to relax afterwards as they took comfort in the fact that they had just prevented a second droid uprising and were able to maintain stability within Galactic Empire rather than help build it up more than they already have.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

In [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]],<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> a special detachment of the 501st Legion was dispatched to Kamino with orders to [[Kamino uprising|suppress and destroy]] a [[Kaminoan resistance|covert rebellion on Kamino]]. When the Empire discovered that a group of disgruntled [[Clone Master/Legends|Kaminoan scientists]] had taken it upon themselves to liberate their homeworld. Thus, they created the [[Anti-trooper]]s, an army of clone soldiers created from the genetic template of Jango Fett. In addition to the Anti-troopers, a [[Rail-class Advanced Recon Commando|new generation of ARC troopers]] was engineered to bolster the strength of Kamino's new army. With Kamino's priceless cloning technology in danger of being lost to the Empire, the 501st was tasked with annihilating their renegade clone brothers in order to bring Kamino back into the Empire's fold. To better ensure the success of the mission, the 501st was placed under the command of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], an unaltered clone, who was hired to serve as the mission commander because of his knowledge regarding [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City's]] inner workings.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

[[File:BF2_Kamino_1.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The 501st stormtroopers fight against an army of renegade clones on Kamino.]]
The combined might of the Anti-troopers and ARC troopers was ultimately no match against Fett and the more experienced 501st stormtroopers. After completing several primary objectives such as retrieving Jango Fett's DNA, disabling the clone tanks' life-support systems to prevent the creation of more Anti-troopers and destroying a pair of [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i gunships]], the 501st crowded the remaining enemy clones onto the facility's platforms where they were all exterminated. Though they destroyed the entire rebellion at the cost of killing their own clone brethren, Emperor Palpatine no longer had any faith in the concept of an army created entirely from just one man. Hence, new genetic sources were introduced and resulted in [[Clone stormtrooper|stormtrooper clones]] that were not based on the Fett template. Not long afterward, the Stormtrooper Corps began recruiting real Humans into their ranks. As a result of the huge influx of different clones and enlisted troopers, the Fett clones were reduced as a small minority within the army that they once filled as a whole.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

Stormtroopers of the 501st were also stationed at the ruins of the Jedi Temple at some point when Darth Vader's [[Sith apprentice/Legends|secret apprentice]] [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] [[Starkiller's Trial of the Spirit|arrived]] in search of the [[Great Holocron/Legends|Great Holocron]]. Since the apprentice could not afford to be discovered by Emperor Palpatine, he was instructed by Vader to kill all who saw him. Thus, Starkiller eradicated a number of 501st troopers guarding the Temple in order to preserve the secrecy of his existence.<ref name="Force Unleashed">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref>

===Galactic Civil War===
{{Quote|For months we had treated the Rebellion like a disobedient child, only to have our tolerance repaid with treachery on an unimaginable scale.|Entry from the 501st Journal|<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />}}<br />

=====Prisoner Riot on the Death Star=====
In 0 BBY, the 501st were stationed on board the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Star]], an assignment that many of the troopers found to be dull and unbearable as they had been used to fighting on the front lines, and instead were tasked to perform either guard duty or be on patrol through the Death Star's endless corridors. Little did they know that they would soon have their first encounter with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. A group of prisoners, led by a captured Jedi Knight, [[Death Star Uprising|rebelled]] and took over one of the cell blocks, having plans to download the station's schematics and then flee on one of the shuttles. While many of the higher ups found the situation to be disastrous, the 501st saw it as good opportunity to get back in the fight and were soon deployed to quell the riot.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

A trooper of the 501st Legion was on guard duty in the Hanger control room when he was contacted by command, who told him that the riot was currently in process in one of the detention areas. Being told that a detachment of the Legion was aboard an incoming shuttle from an inspection, the trooper was ordered to rendezvous with his squadmates and hold off the incoming prisoners, who were planning on taking the shuttle the 501st had just arrived in. While the prisoners proved to be more dangerous than expected, the 501st were ultimately able to hold off the prisoners and were ordered to take over the captured cell block. Upon accomplishing this task, the 501st were informed that a prisoner was in possession of the Death Star plans and was trying to make a break for it. After killing the prisoner and returning the plans, the 501st were informed that the prisoners had taken over the the station's fire control room and were ordered to take it back before the prisoners could damage the main cannon. After intensive fighting, the Legion was ordered to make their way to a nearby hanger bay, where the prisoners had managed to capture one of the shuttles and were planning to soon take off. While the Legion managed to destroy the shuttle, the riot's Jedi leader soon appeared and began to attack the 501st, with command ordering them to eliminate the Jedi traitor. While the Jedi proved to be a worthy adversary, the 501st were able to eliminate him and bring an end to the riot.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

[[File:BF_Polis_Massa_5.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Rebel soldiers attacking 501st stormtroopers on Polis Massa.]]
While they ultimately put an end to the riot, the 501st handling of the situation was seen as embarrassing by many Imperial officers, as the troopers of the 501st were considered to be the best. For their embarrassment, the 501st were reassigned under Vader once more and were tasked with assisting him find the stolen Death Star plans.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

The 501st soon learned that the plans they thought they had recovered was a decoy. They followed Vader around the galaxy, trying desperately to get back the lost plans. Following a [[Raid on Polis Massa|battle]] on [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]] in which the Rebellion put up a much greater fight than expected, the 501st once again thought that they had recovered the plans. Much to Vader's displeasure, they learned that it was once again a decoy from the Alliance.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

[[File:Stormswarm.jpg|thumb|left|200px|501st stormtroopers swarming onto the ''Tantive IV''.]]
They then learned that [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] had the plans. With that information, the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] followed the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], Organa's ship.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" /> Above the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the ''Devastator'' managed to [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|disable]] the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvette]]. The 501st then stormed the ship, and stunned Organa, but failed to locate the plans, as an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] containing them had been jettisoned.<ref name="anh">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

Though some troopers were by now tired of this chase, they were not so foolish as to voice their complaints, and suspected that soon this pursuit would be over. The unit believed that Organa would cave in to Vader's methods of persuasion, and inform him of all the Alliance's secrets. However, she refused to divulge any secrets, even under [[Torture/Legends|torture]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

Meanwhile, the 501st was stationed onboard the Death Star. Much to their displeasure, Organa was able to escape from her [[Cell 2187/Legends|cell]] with the help of several Rebels who managed to infiltrate the Death Star. The Alliance finally received the plans, and was able to discover a weak spot in the battlestation's defenses—an unshielded [[Thermal exhaust port/Legends|thermal exhaust port]] located on the surface. Unfortunately for the Alliance, the Empire had finally discerned the location of the Rebellion's secret base—the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Taking the Death Star to the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], the Empire expected to finally emerge victorious. However, in the subsequent [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|battle]], the Rebel Alliance was able to destroy the Death Star.<ref name="anh" /> Around two thirds of the men of the 501st died in the explosion. In response, the remnants of the 501st joined the Empire's [[Yavin blockade|blockade]] of Yavin 4. The legion managed to destroy a number of [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] and starfighters in space before landing on the surface. There, they managed to kill three Bothans who were among the Alliance leadership. Still, the 501st was furious, as they felt like they had overlooked the Rebellion, only to pay for it with the lives of millions. The men were determined to end this threat once and for all.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]], the unit was sent to [[Makrin City]] along with Vader on a [[Skirmish on Shelkonwa|mission]] to capture Leia Organa and arrest [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Barshnis Choard]] for [[Treason/Legends|high treason]]. Though Organa escaped with the help of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Hand of Judgment|five rogue stormtroopers]], Choard was arrested and taken into custody.<ref name="Allegiance">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>

[[File:VadersFist-TheBattleOfHoth.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vader's Fist invades [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the 501st took part in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] along with [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]]. The unit destroyed the Alliance's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]], and placed a [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacon]] under the last Rebel [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|transport]], allowing several Star Destroyers to bombard the planet, decimating the transport and killing a number of Rebels. Overall, the battle was an Imperial rout. The 501st believed they had finally ended the Rebel Alliance threat, calling this battle their finest hour.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" /> However, a [[4 ABY/Legends|year later]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the Rebel Alliance destroyed the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]] with Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader onboard. The Empire, and the 501st, was in shambles.<ref name="rotj">{{Film|VI}}</ref><ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

===Fall of the Empire and rebirth===
{{Quote|Many years ago Thrawn told us that if he was ever reported dead we should keep at our labors here and in the Unknown Regions, and to look for his return ten years afterward.|[[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]]|<ref name="Vision">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
After the fall of the Empire, the squabbling of numerous Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] caused the 501st Legion to be dissolved and its soldiers assigned to other units. Upon assuming command of the Imperial military in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] reconstituted the 501st Legion, knowing the symbolism of the legion's name and reputation. Thrawn assigned the new 501st to protect the [[Empire of the Hand]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] while he attempted to restore the galaxy under Imperial rule.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] also took the step of incorporating non-Humans into the 501st, something that would have been considered unthinkable under Palpatine.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /><ref name="bargain">''[[Fool's Bargain]]''</ref> As reformed, the most basic unit in the 501st was a squad of four troopers, capable of acting as a fire team within a larger force, but also able to serve as a self-supporting commando team on special missions. Also as a result of the Empire's collapse and Thrawn's reforms, the new 501st Legion was no longer composed by a super majority of Jango Fett's clones. As with the rest of the Stormtrooper Corps, the ranks of the 501st became dominated by enlisted troopers, Human and non-Human alike.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

In [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]], the 501st Legion's [[Unit Aurek-Seven]] helped Luke and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] explore the crashed ship ''[[Outbound Flight]]''. With the aid of the stormtroopers and [[Chak Fel]], the son of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], the Jedi were able to [[Battle of the Redoubt|defeat]] the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]].<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> The 501st's service to the Empire of the Hand was short-lived, however, when the fledgling state was dissolved and its territories annexed to the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]].<ref name="Atlas" /> Despite the fall of Thrawn's Empire, the 501st Legion continued to exist as a military unit under the new [[Fel Empire|Empire]], a successor-state to the former Galactic Empire.<ref name="Legacy 0">[[Star Wars: Legacy (2006) 0|''Star Wars: Legacy'' (2006) 0]]</ref>

[[File:Legacy501st.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Members of the 501st Legion in 130 ABY]]
The inclusion of non-Humans into the 501st intensified over the years, thus necessitating the creation of specialized armor was created for certain species. Further reforms also enabled females to serve as stormtroopers in the 501st as well. By the year [[130 ABY]], the 501st Legion was still an active unit in the Empire, at the time ruled by [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]]. In the same year, the Empire succeeded in reconquering most of the known galaxy after defeating the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] in the [[Sith–Imperial War]]. However, the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|resurgent Galactic Empire]] experienced a regime change when Fel was deposed and forced into exile by a [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Attack on Emperor Fel|coup d'état]]. When [[Darth Krayt]] declared himself [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|the new Emperor of the galaxy]], the 501st Legion continued its service under the Empire's new sovereign.<ref name="Legacy 0" /><ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 3: Broken, Part 3" />

In the year [[137 ABY]], the 501st was stationed on [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Oron Jaeger]]. After spending nearly a decade hiding from Krayt's forces, the fugitive emperor, Roan Fel, returned to Bastion with the goal of using the former Imperial Capital as his base of operations. Although [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Kiefer]] remained staunchly loyal to Darth Krayt, Fel gave an impassioned plea to Bastion's military garrison, urging the soldiers to serve him once again. To Kiefer's surprise, the stormtroopers of the 501st Legion knelt before the deposed monarch, thus signaling their switch of allegiance from Krayt to Fel. Kiefer, outraged by the 501st's betrayal, declared for Krayt and attempted to execute Fel on the spot—only to be fatally shot in the back by mutinous stormtroopers. General Jaeger personally welcomed Roan Fel and committed the 501st Legion to his cause.<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 3: Broken, Part 3" />

[[File:Fel_Bastion.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The 501st Legion kneels in the presence of Emperor Roan Fel in 137 ABY.]]
With Bastion [[Fall of Bastion|secured]] as the center of the so-called "[[Empire-in-exile|True Empire]]," the 501st Legion remained on the planet and served as the exiled emperor's praetorian guard throughout the duration of the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].<ref name="Star Wars: Legacy 3: Broken, Part 3" /> Roughly a year later, Darth Krayt perished in the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Coruscant]] and his Galactic Empire ceased to exist by [[138 ABY]]. However, Roan Fel died in the same battle as well. With both emperors dead, the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]] was formed to establish a new form of rule over the known galaxy. The Triumvirs consisted of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[K'Kruhk]] and Roan Fel's successor—[[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Marasiah Fel]].<ref name="Legacy-War6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>

==Notable members==
A number of troopers fought in the 501st over the years. Originally an ordinary unit, the 501st developed into an elite squad under the direction of Chancellor Palpatine. Following the rise of the Empire, the unit became Darth Vader's personal legion, receiving the nickname "Vader's Fist". The members of the legion gained a reputation for being ruthless and efficient.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" /> Following the Battle of Endor, non-Humans were eventually integrated into the legion, and a number of reforms took place.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

===CT-7567 (Rex)===
[[File:RexBadass-TCWCUK626.png|thumb|left|180px|CT-7567]]
{{Quote|If we can't stop them, then we delay them as long as we can, and after that we make sure they have to crawl over our bodies. It's been an honor, gentlemen.|Rex, to Torrent Company, during the Battle of Teth|<ref name="TCWn" />}}
{{Main|Rex/Legends}}
